items.title: Library supplement: Global C² regularity of one Hermite class

source.anchor: F4 in source-only.json; proof topology P3.
source.attribution: Original generic exposition of Gaussian polynomial and finite Hermite features; existing proofs reused without a novelty or primary-textbook completion claim.

items.statement: Let \(E\) be a finite-dimensional real inner-product normed space with its Borel structure, and let \(\gamma_E=\operatorname{stdGaussian}(E)\) be the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. Let \(H_j\) be the unnormalized probabilists Hermite polynomial and put \(h_j(w)=[x\mapsto H_j(\langle w,x\rangle)]\in L^2(\gamma_E)\). For a finite set \(S\subset\mathbb N\) and real coefficients \(c_j\), put \(F_{S,c}(w)=\sum_{j\in S}c_jh_j(w)\). For every natural degree \(j\), the actual class map \(h_j\) is globally twice continuously Fréchet differentiable on all of \(E\).
assumptions: The finite-dimensional real inner-product and Borel structures are the actual structures on the same carrier \(E\).
\(\gamma_E\) is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. No positive dimension restriction is imposed.
\(j\) is arbitrary; the parameter vector is not restricted to the sphere.
